# 3 Axial Skyrmions

*   The reflection operation flips the sign of only one pion field, resulting in a definition of relative phase that deviates by π compared to prior works [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by reversing the signs of all three pion fields.
*   The approach used in this paper aligns better with the behavior observed in monopoles. (3.10)

# Skyrmion and AntiSkyrmion Patching and Initial Conditions

*   The profile function becomes zero at a distance of s/2 from the Skyrmion/antiSkyrmion center.
*   This characteristic allows the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be linked in a continuous fashion, with the fields assuming vacuum values outside the respective cores.
*   Apart from the primary initial conditions based on ansatz (3.7), the study also implemented complex initial conditions using the rational map ansatz [11], which incorporates an axially symmetric charge n map.
